title: AI ETHICS ISSUES IN REAL WORLD: EVIDENCE FROM AI INCIDENT DATABASE

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative content analysis of 150 real-world AI ethics incidents from the AI Incident Database to categorize and calculate the frequency of racial discrimination in various application areas.
